edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: The same inflammatory and placental-stress pathways are used to explain links between poor maternal periodontal health and low birth weight.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2023 Khan systematic review in J Pak Med Assoc already points to periodontal disease in pregnancy tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
